scope: Independent AI bilingual prose review plus a separately written direct semantic oracle and recursive AST evaluator. No previous corpus/model output or author oracle source was used. No API or network calls. Frozen files unchanged.

stages.semanticReview: Both languages scope the resident-and-scholarship exception solely to youth guardian consent. They retain the age and resident/student/member restrictions. Only exact closing inclusion differs; scholarship then member fee precedence is shared.

Eligibility, guardian consent and explicit leap-day UTC interval match. Alice prioritizes member-with-consent, resident, student, scholarship. Bob prioritizes scholarship, student, member-with-consent, resident. Both possible price directions and maxima are correct.

Alice negated none-of status is equivalent to Bob at-least-one status. Remaining-person fee clauses match Bob explicit first-match order. Bob source is byte-identical; the selected scholarship attendee changes from USD16 to zero.

Both languages give alternative whole prices for overlapping resident/student/scholarship categories without a conflict priority. Whole rules must remain null; no smallest-price or source-order assumption is justified.

limits: This validates the held-out expectations, not the model outputs.
